description: Java source code for ChargesApiResource class, which provides REST API endpoints for managing charges (fees and penalties) in the Fineract platform. Includes methods for retrieving, creating, updating, and deleting charges.

classes.name: ChargesApiResource
classes.description: REST API resource class for managing charges in the Fineract platform, including endpoints for CRUD operations.

methods.name: retrieveAllCharges
methods.description: Returns a list of all defined charges.

methods.name: retrieveCharge
methods.description: Returns details of a specific charge by ID, optionally including a template.

methods.name: retrieveNewChargeDetails
methods.description: Provides a template with default values for creating a new charge.

methods.name: createCharge
methods.description: Creates a new charge based on provided charge request data.

methods.name: updateCharge
methods.description: Updates an existing charge identified by chargeId.

methods.name: deleteCharge
methods.description: Deletes a charge identified by chargeId.
